comment: Configuration for ppxai - customize providers, models, and autorouting behavior
system_prompt: You are an expert AI coding assistant. Be concise and precise. When using tools, execute them directly and report results briefly. Focus on code quality, correctness, and best practices.
__comment_system_prompt: Global system prompt prepended to all conversations (v1.13.6+). Per-provider overrides below.
__comment_system_prompt_mode: How to combine with tool instructions: 'prepend' (default), 'append', or 'replace'

server.__comment_idle_timeout: Auto-shutdown after N seconds of inactivity. 0 = disabled (server runs forever)
server.__comment_working_dir: Default working directory for sessions. null = user home directory. Set to e.g. '/workspace' for container deployments.

secrets.__comment: Pluggable bearer-token sources for /v1/tokens + auth (v1.19.0, ADR 0003 §C2). OMIT this whole block for the legacy behavior: a single shared token via the PPXAI_API_TOKEN env var (unauthenticated when unset). Providers are tried in order; the first to resolve a presented token wins. /v1/tokens mint/list/revoke route to the first provider that supports them — read-only providers (env, k8s) return HTTP 405.

providers.__comment: Mutable, single-machine MVP. Stores salted SHA-256 hashes (never raw material); mint returns the token once. File is created owner-only (0600 / owner ACL on Windows). Supports mint/list/revoke via /v1/tokens.
Read-only legacy single-shared-token. Kept alongside 'file' so existing deployments keep working during migration. Operator rotates by updating the env var. Does NOT support mint/list/revoke (405).

secrets.__comment_future: v1.20.x will add read-only 'k8s' (namespace/secret/key) and full 'vault' providers behind the same interface; an unknown 'type' is skipped with a warning so a newer config degrades on an older server instead of crashing.

session.__comment_auto_restore: How to restore sessions on startup: 'always', 'prompt' (default), 'never'
session.__comment_auto_save_interval: Save session every N messages (0 = every message, 1 = default)

context.__comment_max_injection_size: Max chars per @file/@git/@tree injection (default: 100KB). Increase for larger files.
context.__comment_default_context_limit: Default model context window in tokens. Override per-model in providers section.
context.__comment_warn_at_percent: Show warning when context usage exceeds this % of model limit (0 = disabled)

bootstrap.__comment: Bootstrap context from project instruction files (v1.14.0+)
bootstrap.__comment_files: Filenames to search for project instructions. All matches loaded with scope labels. Empty list disables bootstrap.
bootstrap.__comment_enabled: Set to false to disable bootstrap context loading entirely

paths.__comment: Binary and data paths (v1.13.2+). Use {home} for home directory
paths.__comment_bin_search_paths: Directories to search for ppxai binaries (ppxai, ppxai-server, ppxai-desktop). Windows paths checked first.
paths.__comment_data_dir: Directory for sessions, exports, usage data, and config files

perplexity.name: Perplexity AI

perplexity.system_prompt: You have two capabilities: (1) NATIVE WEB SEARCH for research, facts, and current information - use this automatically for questions and cite sources as markdown links. (2) EXTERNAL TOOLS for file operations, shell commands, and editing - when tools are available and the user asks to DO something (cd, ls, edit, fix, run, create, analyze), execute the appropriate tool immediately instead of explaining how. For actions: act first, report results briefly. For questions: search and cite. Never tell the user to do manually what a tool can do.

gemini.__comment_deprecations: Gemini deprecation timeline (verified 2026-04-12 against https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations; gemini-3.1-flash-lite GA migration verified 2026-05-14). The Gemini 2.0 and 2.5 families were REMOVED from this example file in v1.17.4 because all variants are scheduled for shutdown between 2026-06-01 and 2026-07-22. `/doctor` still knows about them via `ppxai/engine/model_deprecations.py` — users with old local configs get a warning with upgrade targets. Recommended replacements: gemini-3-flash-preview (best benchmark score, 100%) for general coding, gemini-3.1-pro-preview for complex reasoning, gemini-3.1-flash-lite (GA 2026-05) for high-volume cost-sensitive workloads. gemini-3-pro-preview was SHUT DOWN 2026-03-09. gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview retires 2026-05-25 — use the GA name gemini-3.1-flash-lite.

agent.__comment_moved_v1_19_1: BREAKING (v1.19.1, ADR 0010): task_tier_enabled and sandbox.* are NO LONGER read here. They describe WHERE work runs, not what the agent tool is, and moved to execution.task.* (see the top-level 'execution' block below). There is no dual-read — a stale copy under tools.agent is silently ignored. Run /doctor for the old->new mapping.

container.__comment_require_consent: Require user approval before container operations

vision_model.__comment: Vision-language sidecar for text-only models (v1.17.4 Phase 2.7). When the user attaches an image while chatting with a text-only model (e.g. o1-mini, gpt-oss, sonar-reasoning), ppxai can optionally fetch a caption from a separate VL endpoint and inject it as a text placeholder. Unset / disabled = fallback to a '[Image: name — vision not supported]' placeholder.
vision_model.__comment_enabled: Set to true to enable the VL sidecar fallback path.
vision_model.__comment_endpoint: OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint serving a VL model (e.g. 'http://localhost:11434/v1' for Ollama, 'http://dgx-node:8001/v1' for vLLM).
vision_model.__comment_model: Model ID to call on that endpoint (e.g. 'qwen2.5vl:7b', 'llava:34b', 'Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct').
vision_model.__comment_api_key_env: Optional env var holding the API key. Leave empty for no-auth local endpoints.
vision_model.__comment_auto_caption: When true, /attach + file_preprocessing call the VL sidecar automatically for images attached to text-only models. When false, the sidecar is wired but only used when explicitly invoked.
vision_model.__comment_timeout: Request timeout in seconds — VL models can be slow on first load.
vision_model.__comment_max_tokens: Max caption length in tokens. Captions are short — 200 is plenty.
vision_model.prompt: Describe this image in one or two sentences. Focus on what would help a text-only language model reason about it.
vision_model.__comment_prompt: System prompt handed to the VL model alongside the image.

display_limits.__comment_default: Default character limit for tool result display (applies to tools without specific limits)

get_weather.__comment: Format-aware limits for weather tool - different truncation per format parameter

execution.__comment: ADR 0010 third config axis (v1.19.1): WHERE work runs. providers.* say WHO answers, tools.* say WHAT each tool is (tier-independently), and execution.* says how each execution surface runs — tiers, their enablement, grants, sandbox, egress ceiling and consent all read top-to-bottom in this one block.

run.__comment: The one-off tier: the /run command family and the /v1/oneshot facade. Both keys default OFF, so shipped /v1/oneshot behavior is byte-identical until an operator opts in.
run.__comment_web_search: Expose the web_search tool loop to oneshot runs (ADR 0009 enrichment). The ONLY tool the one-off tier can ever grant.
run.__comment_grounding: Provider-NATIVE web search on the oneshot path (no tool exposed, perimeter unchanged). Supersedes tools.web_search.oneshot_grounding, which is still dual-read until it retires.

execution.__comment_collect: How /run + /task results reach the active session: 'auto' (always auto-merge on completion) | 'yes' (held until the Collect button/verb finalizes+merges; default) | 'no' (collect disabled: button greyed, verb warns, result stays on the run record).

task.__comment: The tool-capable POST /v1/agent/task tier. BREAKING (v1.19.1, ADR 0010): these keys moved wholesale from tools.agent.* with NO dual-read — enabled was task_tier_enabled, and consent/budgets were flat tools.agent keys. Run /doctor for the full old->new mapping.
task.__comment_enabled: v1.19.0 (was tools.agent.task_tier_enabled): opt-in for the tool-capable tier. Default false. This tier is sandboxed IN-PROCESS ONLY (no OS isolation) and is safe ONLY for trusted operators — enable deliberately. The tool-free POST /v1/agent/run tier is always available regardless.
task.__comment_sandbox: v1.19.x build plan T2 (was tools.agent.sandbox): filesystem SEAL for the tool-capable tier. Off by default. Set enforcement='in_process' to confine a run's reads to read_paths.allow (+ skills_dir/specs_dir + its per-run workdir) and writes to the per-run workdir only. deny globs override allow (deny wins). A bare name in deny (e.g. '.env', 'secrets') blocks that file/dir anywhere in the tree; a '/'-containing pattern (e.g. '/abs/path', '**/x') matches the full path. Best-effort under trusted-operator (a path-prefix jail, not an OS boundary); enforcement='container' (tier-d, not yet built) realizes the SAME fields as read-only mounts + ConfigMaps. To activate, set enforcement and read_paths.allow below.

sandbox.__comment_skills_dir: v1.19.0 (/task T4): a directory of agent SKILL directories. When set, `POST /v1/agent/task {"skills":["<name>"]}` (and the web `/task run --skill <name>`) resolves <name> under this dir (NAME only — no path/traversal). Each skill is `<name>/SKILL.md` (a spec, T3 loader) + optional `references/` (mounted into the run read-scope when enforcement=in_process) + optional `scripts/` (INERT). Multiple skills compose: grants union, read-roots union, still clamped by the ceiling (no-shell, execution.task.enabled). A scripts/-bearing skill is refused unless allow_skill_scripts is true. null = skills disabled.
sandbox.__comment_specs_dir: v1.19.0 (/task T3): a directory of agent spec files. When set, `POST /v1/agent/task {"spec":"<name>"}` (and the web `/task run --spec <name>`) resolves <name> under this dir (NAME only — no path/traversal; .md front-matter, .json, .yaml). Spec fields fill any omitted request field; explicit request fields win; the merged grant is clamped by the same ceiling as a direct request (no-shell, execution.task.enabled). null = spec files disabled.
sandbox.__comment_allow_skill_scripts: v1.19.0 (/task T4): scripts/ in a skill can never execute in the in-process tier (no shell grant). Default false REFUSES a scripts/-bearing skill up front (400) rather than loading it with silently-inert scripts. Set true to acknowledge scripts stay inert and load the skill anyway; running skill scripts needs the container tier (T9).

consent.__comment_spawn_consent: v1.19.0 Inc 7 (was tools.agent.spawn_consent): server-context spawn_subagent policy. 'deny' (default, safe) PARKS a spawn needing consent in waiting{consent} until POST .../respond answers it — an unanswered park denies on TTL expiry (fail-closed). 'auto' lets API-driven spawns proceed with the capability SUBSET rules (child grant ⊆ parent, egress ⊆ parent, no-shell, depth=1) as the boundary.
consent.__comment_consent_ttl_s: v1.19.x T5 (was tools.agent.consent_ttl_s): how long a waiting{consent} park stays answerable before resolving to a denial (seconds).

budgets.__comment_result_retention_s: v1.19.x T6 (was tools.agent.result_retention_s): how long a completed_pending_ack run holds its uncollected result before the lazy reaper finalizes it (seconds; reaped on next read — no timer task). 0 disables the backstop. Finalizing never deletes data — it only marks the run GC-eligible.

execution.__comment_default_subagent: v1.19.0 (was tools.agent.default_subagent): provider/model for spawned sub-agent runs when the spawn request doesn't specify. Resolution: request value -> this -> 400. Deliberately NOT the interactive session's chat provider — a sub-agent's model is per-task intent, not inherited from the UI. Lives at the execution root because it composes grants ACROSS tiers.
execution.__comment_profiles: ADR 0009 §1: named, reusable task grants. Each profile is AgentSpec-shaped ({tools?, network?, budget?, provider?, model?, system?, enrichment?}); a run selects one by name (--profile <name>). Precedence: request > spec > profile > default_subagent > built-in default, with list fields REPLACING (not unioning) so a more specific layer can narrow.
execution.__comment_egress_ceiling: ADR 0009 Q3: deployment-wide egress cap. Config-only and INTERSECTIVE — a run's effective allowlist is the intersection of whatever it resolved with this list. A run can never state or raise it. Unset/absent = no cap. A malformed (non-list) value is a hard error, never a silent 'no cap'.

file_tree.__comment_ignore_dirs: Directory names hidden from the file tree. REPLACE semantics (not merge) — your list is used verbatim. Empty list = show everything. Default: ['.git', 'node_modules', '__pycache__', '.venv', 'venv', '.tox', 'dist', 'build', '.eggs', '.mypy_cache']. Remove an entry from the default list to unhide that dir (e.g. drop 'venv' if you want it visible).
